title: Drone Surveillance Risk Calculator - Assess Your Privacy Exposure
metaDescription: Calculate your drone surveillance risk based on location, activities, and protection measures. Get personalized privacy recommendations.
description: Evaluate your exposure to drone surveillance with our privacy risk calculator. Input your location type, activities, and current protection measures to receive a personalized risk score and actionable steps to protect your privacy.

inputs.helpText: Where you spend most of your time affects drone surveillance likelihood

inputs.helpText: More outdoor time increases exposure to aerial surveillance

formula: const locationRisk = {urban: 0.3, suburban: 0.2, rural: 0.1, commercial: 0.35, industrial: 0.15}[locationType]; const outdoorRisk = outdoorTime * 0.02; const activityRisk = {never: 0, rarely: 0.05, sometimes: 0.15, frequently: 0.3}[sensitiveActivities]; const privacyBonus = {none: 0, minimal: -0.05, partial: -0.1, good: -0.2, excellent: -0.3}[propertyPrivacy]; const awarenessBonus = {none: 0, basic: -0.02, moderate: -0.05, high: -0.1}[droneAwareness]; const socialRisk = {always: 0.2, frequently: 0.15, sometimes: 0.1, rarely: 0.05, never: 0}[locationSharing]; const privateRisk = privateActivities ? 0.1 : 0; const baseRisk = locationRisk + outdoorRisk + activityRisk + socialRisk + privateRisk; const adjustedRisk = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, baseRisk + privacyBonus + awarenessBonus)); const riskScore = Math.round(adjustedRisk * 100); const exposureScore = Math.round((locationRisk + outdoorRisk + socialRisk + privateRisk) * 100); let riskLevel; if (riskScore < 20) riskLevel = 'Low Risk'; else if (riskScore < 40) riskLevel = 'Moderate Risk'; else if (riskScore < 60) riskLevel = 'High Risk'; else riskLevel = 'Very High Risk'; return {riskScore, riskLevel, exposureScore};

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates drone surveillance risk by analyzing location patterns, outdoor exposure time, activity sensitivity, physical privacy measures, and digital footprint. The scoring system considers how these factors combine to create surveillance opportunities and applies protective measures as risk reducers.
tips: Install physical barriers like tall fences, privacy screens, or plant dense trees to block aerial views
Vary your outdoor routines and timing to make surveillance tracking more difficult
Use Incognito Browser when researching sensitive topics to avoid creating digital profiles
Learn to identify drone sounds and visual signatures to increase detection awareness
Avoid posting real-time location data on social media platforms
Consider drone detection apps that can alert you to nearby surveillance drones
Know your local drone laws and regulations regarding surveillance and privacy
Create privacy zones in your yard using umbrellas, awnings, or temporary covers
Be aware of increased drone activity during events, protests, or gatherings

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Minimal drone surveillance exposure. Continue current privacy practices and stay informed about local drone activity.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Some surveillance exposure risk. Consider adding physical privacy barriers and increasing drone awareness.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant surveillance risk. Implement multiple privacy measures and limit sensitive outdoor activities.

interpretation.label: Very High Risk
interpretation.description: Major surveillance exposure. Take immediate action to increase privacy protection and consider professional security consultation.
